name: A Last Request

faq.answer: The fallen peacekeeper's identity is unknown when you find him. He kept order, and his duty ended violently. Only an urgent message remains in his hands.

The note recounts the peacekeeper's final account. The cult surprised his post. Raani never saw it coming, Arvensus took a sword to the gut, and a lightning bolt felled the writer. Left for dead, he expected his wounds to finish what the cult began.
faq.q: What is written on the bloody note?

aliases: how to start a last request
where is a last request found
faq.answer: You find the peacekeeper's body in the field and examine it. The bloody note in his hands holds his final plea.

The cult ambushed the peacekeeper's post without warning. His fellows fell, and a lightning bolt struck him, leaving him for dead. He lived long enough to record what happened in the note found in his hands.
The peacekeeper died before he could finish his mission or deliver his message. You can retrieve and read his bloodstained note, decipher his final instructions, and fulfill his dying wish.
faq.q: What is the peacekeeper's last request?

faq.answer: Peacekeepers protect settlements and roads, keeping order and defending them from danger. When one falls in the field, their duties remain unfinished and their allies unwarned unless someone recovers their final report.

sections.body: You find a dead peacekeeper in the field with a bloodstained note in his hands. When you examine him, the note slips free. On Zephras, peacekeepers risk their lives to keep order. His last words may tell what happened to him.
sections.title: A Grim Discovery

sections.body: The bloodied parchment holds the peacekeeper's final plea or instructions. Whoever killed him left his duty unfinished. Read the clues and complete his final mission. The note points the way to answer his dying call.
sections.title: The Final Message

summary: On Zephras, a fallen peacekeeper carries a message that may reveal his final moments. His bloodstained note points to the duty he left unfinished.
attribution: In-game quest text: A Last Request
